title: Halo workload profile batcher controller: adaptive recommendations and guarded apply
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Build an adaptive recommendation engine ("Halo" scorer) that profiles inbound workloads, suggests per-workload batching and prefix/KV-caching configurations, and executes safe, observable applies with automatic rollback triggers. Aim for continuous parameter tuning with conservative defaults and explicit safety gates for production applies.
problem_statement: Current batching suggestions rely on episodic profiling and manual tuning. We lack a single scoring function that synthesizes burstiness, sequence-length dispersion, and KV cache hit patterns into stable per-workload parameters. As a result, customers either leave suboptimal defaults (higher cost) or operators apply risky batch increases that cause p99 latency regressions. We need an automated, auditable pipeline that recommends parameters and can safely apply them with rollback controls.
goals: Design and implement the Halo scoring model to rank candidate batching/caching profiles for a workload
Provide an API + Console UI surface for suggested config and a one-click guarded apply flow
Implement shadow and canary apply paths plus automated rollback criteria tied to SLOs and error signals
Enable continuous re-tuning with hysteresis to avoid flip-flopping parameters
success_metrics: Median per-request token cost reduction for targeted customers >= 12% within 30 days
No more than 0.5% of guarded applies trigger a full rollback due to SLO breach
0% increase in p99 latency for stable workloads after halo apply (target tolerance +5ms)
At least 70% of eligible workloads adopt recommended config within 60 days when auto-suggest enabled
acceptance_criteria: Halo scorer implemented and returns deterministic rank for a given workload fingerprint
Recommendation API endpoint (POST /v1/internal/recs/batch) returns candidate profiles with delta-estimated cost/latency
Console shows recommendation details and risk score; one-click guarded apply triggers shadow/canary according to policy
Guarded apply machinery automatically rolls back when configured SLOs (p95/p99 latency, error-rate, model-safety flags) are exceeded during canary
Audit logs and runbook links are recorded for every apply and rollback event
E2E tests and synthetic workload benchmarks validate no p99 regressions for a set of canonical workloads
implementation_notes: Workload fingerprint: compute (customer_id, route, model_variant) plus short-term stats: arrivals/sec, burst_index (90/50 quantile ratio), seq_len_dispersion (stdev/mean), kv_hit_rate, avg_prefix_sharing

Halo score = weighted sum of normalized signals (burstiness, seq_dispersion, kv_opportunity, latency_headroom). We will expose weights as a tunable config and start with conservative defaults discovered from historical telemetry
Candidate profiles generated from discrete set: micro (microbatch=1, batching_window=0), standard, beveled (aggressive coalesce), kv-primed (prefix cache TTL increase + prefetch policy)
Estimator module runs fast local simulation using cached QPS/latency curves (precomputed per model_variant) to predict token cost delta and p99 impact
Safety gates: predicted p99 delta > +5% OR predicted CPU/GPU utilization > 90% => mark candidate risky and only allow shadow testing
Guarded apply flow: 1) Shadow apply for 24h (telemetry collection), 2) Canary small % of traffic for 1 hour, 3) Ramp with automated checks and 15-minute stabilization windows
Rollback triggers: p99 > SLO_threshold * (1 + tolerance), error-rate spike > 3x baseline, abnormal model outputs flagged by quality-eval hooks
Persist audit events to dedicated table (apply_id, before_profile, after_profile, metrics_snapshot) for postmortem and analytics
Backwards compatibility: keep a config fallback to 'pinned' behavior for enterprise customers who opted out of auto-applies
rollout_plan: Alpha: internal tenants only. Deploy recommendation API + shadowing support. Duration 2 weeks
Beta: select customers opt-in; enable canary applies with ops approvals. Duration 4 weeks
GA: auto-suggestion visible to all customers; auto-apply still opt-in by customer with default conservative policy
Post-GA: iterate weights and candidate profiles based on observed telemetry and A/B tests
testing_plan: Synthetic traffic generator to replay representative bursts and long-tail sequences (see tools/replicator config)
Shadow validation: compare latency histograms and KV hit rates between baseline and candidate profile over 24h windows
Canary gating tests to simulate noisy neighbors and partial GPU degradation conditions
Chaos: inject transient high queueing latency and confirm rollback behavior triggers within policy windows
Unit + integration tests for estimator module covering boundary conditions (very low QPS, very high burstiness)
